messages:
Maria: Kicking off — want to lock the DP intake + success criteria this morning. Proposal attached below, high level.
Jon: 👍 can you paste the intake fields here? easier than opening the doc for a quick read.
Maria: Sure — draft intake form:
```
Company:
Use case / flows to test:
Primary success metric (quantitative):
Qualitative goals / what success looks like:
Expected weekly active users during pilot:
Data sensitivity + PII risk level:
Estimated integration effort (hours):
Point of contact + availability windows:
NDA signed? Y/N
Commitment to 1x weekly feedback call (30m)?: Y/N
Incentives: $3k platform credits + early-access feature prioritization
```
Sam: Nice. Two questions: 1) acceptance criteria — how many customers need to hit the primary metric? 2) what’s the minimum integration effort we accept (we don’t want 40hr embed projects for a 4-week pilot)
Maria: Good points. Draft acceptance criteria idea:
- Pilot length = 4 weeks per partner
- Primary metric threshold: either +10% on conversion (for conversion-focused flows) OR embed latency <= 250ms p95 for interactive use cases
- Minimum integration effort <= 12 hours (basic API integration + sample prompts)
Jon: For latency threshold — should we allow a 2-tier guardrail? e.g., if p95 is 250-350ms, still accepted if partner agrees to extended pilot + joint perf plan
Ava: I like the tiered approach. Also suggest capturing a small prompt + eval set on day 0 so we have baseline quality comparisons.
Maria: Yep — add "baseline eval" to intake and require partners to run our 5-min sample harness on day 0. If quality drops >15% vs baseline, we pause and triage.
LaunchBot: Reminder: weekly DP sync scheduled Thu 10:00 PT — auto-add for participants who agreed to calls.
Sam: For recruitment, we should favor partners that: 1) map to our top 3 verticals, 2) can commit engineering time during pilot week windows, 3) have a clear monetization path. Also prefer customers that already evaluated other vendors (helps benchmarking).
Jon: Logistics: who owns onboarding packet + sandbox creds? I can own sandbox creds + perf instrumentation charts. Maria: I’ll own the onboarding packet + discussion guide.
Ava: Feedback loop: weekly 30m call + an internal thread for async notes. Suggest we use a shared Google sheet with sections: issues, asks, quick wins, rollout blockers. We should also tag each issue with impact (high/med/low) and ownership.
Maria: Agreed. Add requirement that partners assign a "product champion" who can triage asks during pilot.
Sam: Incentives — credits + priority lane are good. Maybe add co-marketing as step 2 if pilot converts. That gives strategic partners more incentive.
Jon: Rollout plan post-pilot: green = promote to Hosted API with preset config; amber = extended pilot + targeted optimization; red = stop and capture learnings. We should include automatic fallback policies in config so we don’t break production.
Maria: Scope negotiation template: we’ll accept feature asks if they are in-scope for pilot (integration + prompts) but custom infra work must be scoped separately. Put a checkbox in intake: "Requires infra/custom work?" Y/N
Ava: How many simultaneous pilots can we support? Ops FYI — we should cap at 6 concurrent to keep QA bandwidth sane.
Maria: OK cap at 6 concurrent partners, prioritization rules: closeness to revenue, engineering lift, and coverage of verticals.
Sam: One more: telemetry + PII — require partners to sign data handling appendix if they plan to send any PII. Must be done before sandbox creds.
Maria: Final action items:
- Jon: set up perf dashboards + instrumentation template by EOD Tue
- Maria: finalize intake form + add baseline eval harness by EOD Mon
- Ava: create feedback sheet template and tagging scheme by Wed
- Sam: draft recruitment email + qualification script by Wed
LaunchBot: Task checklist updated in #product-playbooks
Jon: I'll also add a small API snippet for quickstarts to the onboarding packet:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-rlm-small","prompt":"<example prompt>","max_tokens":128}'
```
Maria: Perfect. If anyone has partner candidates, drop them here or ping me directly. Planning to open recruitment next Tue. :rocket:
Sam: Dropping two prospects: Acme Retail (checkout recs) and HealthSight (HIPAA — need PDA). I'll DM.
Ava: I'll slot a 30m sync tomorrow to walk through the intake form with Jon + Sam. :calendar:
Maria: Thanks team — will update the doc and repost with final intake link.
